drafts.subject: Technip Energies: engineering capacity vs the QA/QC paperwork curve
drafts.body:
Hi Blandine,

Saw the North Field West LNG major contract by QatarEnergy (also Coral Norte FLNG, Mozambique, June 2026; Commonwealth LNG, US, Aug 2025) (undisclosed ('major')) announcement — congratulations on that.

It's the kind of project where QA/QC documentation becomes the critical path: inspection test plans stacking up, NDR/NCR cycles eating engineer-hours, and the handover package growing faster than the team that has to assemble it.

We build AI agents that take that load off engineering teams — they read your existing documentation flows (inside the tools you already use, no migration) and execute the repetitive QA/QC paperwork, with your engineers reviewing instead of typing.

Worth 20 minutes to see whether that's real for Technip Energies? I'll bring the one-pager either way.

Best,
Ashish Mishra
